bibl.title: Models of Virtue, Models of Poetry: The Quest for "Everlasting Fame" in Hellenistic Military Epitaphs.
bibl.seg: Silvia Barbantani, Models of Virtue, Models of Poetry: The Quest for "Everlasting Fame" in Hellenistic Military Epitaphs.
Riemer A. Faber (ed.), Celebrity, Fame, and Infamy in the Hellenistic World = Phoenix. Supplementary Volumes. 58 (Toronto, 2020) pp. 37-69.
bibl.note: Explores the lexicon of glory and fame in encomiastic poetry and dedicatory epigrams, in relationship with the archaic and classical literary tradition, and compares the eulogistic strategies employed by epigrammatists with the ones featured in the best examples of Alexandrian court poetry.
